sources.title: Vector acknowledgement and delivery guarantees
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: Fluent Bit：背壓、輪替與來源保留窗口
related.titleEn: Fluent Bit: backpressure, rotation and source-retention windows
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付1000筆狀態矩陣、各端ACK能力表、交集差集及重送後去重證據，說明至少一次可能產生重複。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver the 1000-row matrix, acknowledgement capability table, set differences and deduplicated retry evidence; acknowledge duplicate delivery possibilities.
related.difference: 建立產生率、未讀偏移、檔案輪替及保留時間表，不能只看代理程序仍在運作就推定無遺失。
related.differenceEn: Track generation rate, unread offsets, rotation and retention; a running agent alone does not establish lossless collection.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 本課完成條件是兩個指定終端皆可讀，故計算交集；不可將兩端成功數直接相加。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 1000個唯一事件，主端可讀980、副端950；逐ID比較得到交集930，聯集恰為1000。 雙端可讀比例930/1000=93%；70筆仍缺至少一端的讀回證據。
來源保留時間必須覆蓋停機加追趕時間；記憶體上限與檔案保留是不同資源邊界。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 來源每秒2MB，暫停120秒，恢復讀取每秒6MB且來源仍產生2MB；檔案保留240秒。 未讀量240MB；追趕240/(6−2)=60秒，最保守窗口120+60=180秒，尚有60秒餘裕。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: This exercise requires readability at both designated endpoints, so completion is an intersection rather than a sum. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. Among 1000 unique events, 980 are readable in the primary, 950 in the copy and 930 in both; their union is 1000. Dual-endpoint readability is 93%; seventy events still lack a read-back from at least one endpoint.

Source retention must cover outage plus catch-up; memory limits and source-file lifetime are distinct resource boundaries. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. Source generation is 2 MB/s, pausing lasts 120 seconds and resumed reading is 6 MB/s with continuing 2 MB/s generation; retention is 240 seconds. Unread data totals 240 MB; catch-up takes 60 seconds, giving a conservative 180-second window and 60-second retention margin.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Wazuh FIM：掃描間隔與短暫變更可見性
related.titleEn: Wazuh FIM: scan intervals and transient-change visibility
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付1000筆狀態矩陣、各端ACK能力表、交集差集及重送後去重證據，說明至少一次可能產生重複。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver the 1000-row matrix, acknowledgement capability table, set differences and deduplicated retry evidence; acknowledge duplicate delivery possibilities.
related.difference: 為10項檔案變更列出開始、結束、前後雜湊與掃描時刻，區分未觀察到和確定沒有變更。
related.differenceEn: Record start, end, before/after hashes and scan times for ten changes, distinguishing unobserved changes from established absence.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 本課完成條件是兩個指定終端皆可讀，故計算交集；不可將兩端成功數直接相加。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 1000個唯一事件，主端可讀980、副端950；逐ID比較得到交集930，聯集恰為1000。 雙端可讀比例930/1000=93%；70筆仍缺至少一端的讀回證據。
排程掃描只能比對取樣時刻的狀態；本課比例是給定時間線可見率，不是產品普遍偵測率。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 掃描在0與300秒；10項變更皆從120秒開始，其中6項持續到360秒、4項在180秒還原。 300秒掃描看見6項，樣本可見率6/10=60%；4項還原不代表從未發生。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: This exercise requires readability at both designated endpoints, so completion is an intersection rather than a sum. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. Among 1000 unique events, 980 are readable in the primary, 950 in the copy and 930 in both; their union is 1000. Dual-endpoint readability is 93%; seventy events still lack a read-back from at least one endpoint.

Scheduled scans compare sampled states; the resulting fraction belongs to this fixture, not universal product detection performance. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. Scans occur at 0 and 300 seconds; ten changes begin at 120, with six lasting to 360 and four reverting at 180. The 300-second scan sees six changes, yielding 60% fixture visibility; four reverted states do not imply no changes occurred.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
